info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Hotel Rooms Amenities-v2-spec
info.description: The Hotel Room Amenities API enables users to access detailed information about the amenities available for hotel rooms. This endpoint provides a comprehensive list of amenities that guests can expect during their stay, helping them to make informed bookings. Typical consumers include travel agencies, hotel management systems, and mobile applications aimed at improving guest experiences. By utilizing this API, developers can enhance their applications with up-to-date amenity offerings and promote better guest satisfaction.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of amenities for rooms.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch all available amenities that can be associated with rooms. It provides details on the types of amenities that guests can expect during their stay, enhancing their booking experience.
